facilities.name: Örnatorpet Ullared
facilities.description: Lodging/ranch near the route after the Ullared start; official route difficulty notes the hill near Örnatorpet.

facilities.name: Järnvägsbro till Pyttebanan
facilities.description: Old Pyttebanan railway bridge over Högvadsån with historical information; official place text says there is a picnic table/bench and information sign.

facilities.name: Rastplats vid den gamla järnvägsbron
facilities.description: Bench table before the old Pyttebanan railway bridge; information sign nearby.

facilities.name: B&B Horsared
facilities.description: Official place text says B&B Horsared lies right by Hallandsleden and offers accommodation in an old-style cottage environment with kitchen and shower/WC.

facilities.name: Banvallen till Pyttebanan
facilities.description: Information point on the former Falkenbergs Järnväg/Pyttebanan railway embankment. Official page describes railway history and the origin of the Pyttebanan name.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Kärnebygd / Kärnebygds vindskydd
facilities.coordinateSource: Hallandsleden places API / Naturkartan / Falkenberg municipality
facilities.description: Shelter/campsite cluster near the Kärnebygd end. Hallandsleden says shelter for 4-5 people, fireplace, firewood storage, dry toilet and view. Falkenberg municipality says the shelter sits in a calm open/grazing landscape and the dry toilet is a little way away; see on-site map. Naturkartan confirms shelter, fireplace, dry toilet and view.

facilities.name: Kärnebygds kvarn och såg
facilities.description: Cultural/history site at the dam between Tjärnesjön and Kalvsjön. Official place text says visitors can enter the saw/mill and read signs about mill life and functions. Skogssällskapet confirms ownership/context and restoration with Länsstyrelsen/EU support.

facilities.name: Rastplats Kärnebygds såg
facilities.description: Small rest area with a table by the old Kärnebygd saw and stream.

facilities.name: Viktors affärshus Gårdsbutik med kaffeservering sommartid
facilities.description: Endpoint service at Kärnebygd/Tjärnesjön north end with farm shop and summer cafe according to Hallandsleden. Visit Fegen confirms B&B context and that Hallandsleden passes through Kärnebygd.
